# Hardware test record / 实测记录

| Field / 项目 | Result / 记录 |
| --- | --- |
| Date and operator / 日期、操作者 | |
| Firmware commit and program / 提交、程序 | |
| Test ID / 测试编号 | |
| Battery voltage and power setup / 电压、供电 | |
| Config changes / 参数修改 | |
| Surface, lighting, line width / 地面、光照、线宽 | |
| Target geometry and measured distance / 目标形状、实测距离 | |
| Procedure / 操作步骤 | |
| Expected result / 预期 | |
| Observed result / 实际现象 | |
| Passed trials / total trials / 成功次数、总次数 | |
| Trace, CSV, video / 证据文件 | |
| Problem and correction / 问题、处理 | |
| Retest result / 复测结果 | |

Status / 状态: Not run / 未执行
